The quota is capacity-checked BEFORE seating: plan_site (hamletgen/plan.py) sizes the canvas so the legal ground within reach holds households x the largest envelope at the measured packing density, growing the canvas where it does not - a decision at plan time, not a finished-map retry. The driver's 'a re-roll may not seat fewer' clause (driver.py:484) goes with the re-roll (H16).
rules.fallback: The exhaustive pass exhausts the legal ground only if the ground within reach is physically full of homesteads; the plan-time capacity sizing prevents that for any declared count. Nothing ships under the floor and no whole-map re-roll runs. Residual stated in the impossible list: packing is not exact, so the capacity factor is a measured calibrated liberty.

rules.mechanism: The packer reserves ways (future-work 2b's own design). At seat time each homestead registers an ACCESS CORRIDOR: a footpath-width strip (WEB_FABRIC_GAP x 2) from its door (the yard's open side) to the nearest point of the already-reserved access network or the band's field-side front (the front row reaches the field spur; each rank reaches the corridor of the rank in front). The corridor is a keep-out for every later envelope (it goes into the site boundary's corridor set that _envelope_blocked already reads), so no later homestead can hem the house in; _parts_fit refuses a seat whose corridor cannot be laid clear (one predicate: `access_corridor(s, geom) -> Poly | None`). _serve_stragglers then lays a way along each reserved corridor not already served, so the served network reaches every house by construction. unreached_houses becomes the unit test's predicate, and it measures reach along a path that crosses no other steading (steading_footprints), so the Kuwabata 'through the neighbor's yard' case fails it (FR-003: the check measured straight-line distance). Seat_cluster gains the edge-turn term refusing a field corner of more than ~110 degrees (2b-i), and the skeleton arms are laid through _margin_frame.
rules.fallback: A seat whose corridor cannot be laid is refused and the next offered (H14 carries the count). No house is left unreached, and no roll repeats.
rules.later_stages: stage_web, sweeps (_join_orphan_ways, _bridge_collinear_breaks), smooth and stage_crossings rewrite lanes after the corridors: each must keep every reserved corridor's way (the reach set is re-asserted by the one predicate at the end of each rewriting stage's own unit test, and trims (_trim_to_service) are forbidden to cut a way that is some house's only corridor - it is passed as `keep`).

impossible.rule: H30 - the seat's back to the wind, for a DECLARED fall that runs into the wind
impossible.why: When the declared fall points the wet toe and drain at the wind, every wind-facing margin is below the drain; the drain rule (dwellings_above_field_drain) and the wind rule cannot both hold on that site. Guaranteed for every rolled fall by constraining the roll; a declared spec with such a fall can only be refused at spec load (not a finished-map check, but it does narrow the spec space) - for review.

Rectangle packing is not exact, so plan_site's capacity sizing is a measured factor; the exhaustive pass makes a shortfall require the legal ground within 700 ft to be physically full. A strict guarantee for every conceivable site needs either a reserved lattice of envelope cells before seating (a regular grid - a different settlement form) or unbounded canvas growth. Proposed as guaranteed-by-capacity with the factor calibrated; the reviewer should confirm that counts.

shared_mechanisms.household_lot: ONE per-household lot keyed by seat ordinal (hamletgen/homesteads, new): size ladder rung (H17), kura (H45), byre keeper (H06), fixtures per kind (H32-H35), well pocket (H10/H11). A quota by ordinal (floor((k+1)*p+0.5) > floor(k*p+0.5)) closes every count at round(n*p) for whatever n is seated, and a keeper whose envelope fits nowhere passes its lot to the next seated household. It replaces the positional _hjit rolls that alias along a row (the kura's 2.2x under-delivery).
shared_mechanisms.envelope_parts: Every part a household is guaranteed (kura, byre, fixtures, bath corridor, well pocket, access corridor) is a PART of the bundle laid by rolling/bundle.py:_bundle_layout, boxed in `boxes`, inside the envelope - so fit.py:_envelope_blocked + _parts_fit are the one predicate that decides whether the household is seated, and nothing after the seat can lose the part.
